description: The control point's key (ADR-039 lane L4c): cp: and the number of a main or upper control point (CP 107 is cp:107), or a staging one's name in lower-case words joined by - (cp:east-end). Given once and kept when the name changes. A cp cell of the device pair and of masts.csv names a control point by it (hartlib.places). The four staging interlockings carry their station's name, and a staging cp cell names the station (st:), so no cell names them today.
The control point's name: a staging one by place (Brick), a main or upper one CP and its lowest switch number (owner, 2026-11-15). Unique on its level (hartlib.railroad_facts.read_interlockings).
Its switch numbers, separated by a comma.
The LCOS node area of a main or upper control point; empty on staging, whose areas are the desk areas of stations.csv.
